reviews.reviewer: Codex independent finite Bidi source-role reviewer
reviews.decision: The historical internal/common-module.ts source imported public BidiModule and placed it in both imports and exports of its own local MatCommonModule. That exact path is absent in the reviewed physical snapshot. This is a distinct root-level frozen use, not a family with a one-to-one owner; the root public barrel's ordinary common-module export is removed and the owned core alias remains a separate current source use. The old path's dependency is removed without assuming that the current graph has no other BidiModule uses.
reviews.scope: Exact main-line authored use only; no current-use admission, application behavior, native, AOT, packed, full floor, upstream audit or G11 qualification. Physical absence or presence must be rechecked by the owner.
